text:
**Yes — Monzo is a real, licensed UK bank.** If you open a Monzo current account, your account is with Monzo Bank Limited itself. The app is how you manage it. The Bank of England lists Monzo as a regulated bank. ([bankofengland.co.uk](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/prudential-regulation/authorisations/which-firms-does-the-pra-regulate?utm_source=openai))

If Monzo were to fail, the Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS) would protect eligible deposits up to **£120,000 per person** across your accounts with Monzo Bank Limited, not £120,000 per account. ([monzo.com](https://monzo.com/legal/files/fscs-information/fscs-information-2.0.pdf?utm_source=openai))
